questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All hens are chickens.

All chickens are eggs.

Conclusions:

(I) All hens are eggs.

(II) All eggs are chickens.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c47abb193e5587d98bef8be7f692f6004050cd0c655d97eb9f3efba01f929374.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All hens are eggs → Follow (As all hens are chickens and all chickens are eggs. As whole hens comes in chickens which whole comes in eggs, therefore it is true.)

(II) All eggs are chickens → Does not follow (As all chickens are eggs. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Seven friends, Monu, Abhay, Vicky, Chitti, Deva, Hamza and Sanjay, are attending Hamza's birthday party and sitting in a circular arrangement facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

Monu is an immediate neighbour of Abhay and Deva.

Abhay is second to the left of Hamza.

Sanjay is one of the immediate neighbours of Hamza.

Chitti is an immediate neighbour of both Deva and Vicky.

Who is sitting third to the left of Monu?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven friends, Monu, Abhay, Vicky, Chitti, Deva, Hamza and Sanjay, are attending Hamza's birthday party and sitting in a circular arrangement facing the centre.

1) Monu is an immediate neighbour of Abhay and Deva. 

2) Abhay is second to the left of Hamza.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f042e2f1b6f14184909c4eee6526723367fe89e003225dbceab4ef1c35798f51.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c5e4e05631e4699c58691b9438b0c6ba02779d8565f6a544209fb4c228dbf11.png] 

4) Sanjay is one of the immediate neighbours of Hamza.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ecce7d20e64dcbc2d803cd3421b7b027ba6ca0878b1a14c9e1ae0068e2fc295.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Vicky is sitting third to the left of Monu.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(25, 8, 400)

(12, 14, 336)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

(25, 8, 400)

25 × 8 × 2 = 400

400 = 400 (LHS = RHS) 

And,

(12, 14, 336)

12 × 14 × 2 = 336

336 = 336 (LHS = RHS) 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) (19, 8, 152)

19 × 8 × 2 = 152

304 ≠ 152 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2) (22, 9, 198)

22 × 9 × 2 = 198

396 ≠ 198 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) (17, 11, 189)

17 × 11 × 2 = 189

374 ≠ 189 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 4) (16, 21, 672)

16 × 21 × 2 = 672

**672 = 672 (LHS = RHS)**

Thus, out of all the options, '(16, 21, 672)' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some possums are bisons.

No possum is a wolf.

Conclusions:

[1] All wolves can be bisons.

[2] All bisons are wolves.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ec2825029c962ebcd739a317d59bdbc486d42a4982477c39e0006fa9c85eb7c.png] 

Conclusions:

[1] All wolves can be bisons → Follow (As some possums are bisons and no possum is a wolf. As no statement restricts whole wolf from being bisons, therefore it is true.)

[2] All bisons are wolves → Does not follow (As some possums are bisons and no possum is a wolf. As some part of bisons is common with possums which cannot be wolf, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion [1] follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
